title: Hiyori per-entry document
description: One anime or manga entry as written by the relational publish pipeline to data/<kind>/<hiyori_id>-<slug>.json and returned by GET /api/entries/{id}.

hiyori_id.description: Stable, global, immutable id shared by anime and manga. Allocated once by migration v3 (allocate_hiyori_ids) / `php hiyori hiyori-id --backfill`, recorded in the _hiyori_ids registry.

slug.description: URL-safe, deterministic slug of title. Unique within a kind (unique index kind+slug).

titles.description: Normalized title variants; `default` is the display title, `romaji`/`english`/`native` are variants when known.

type.description: Source format/type, e.g. TV, movie, OVA, manga, novel.

status.description: Release status, e.g. finished, publishing, not_yet_published, on_hiatus, discontinued.

season.description: Anime premiere season, e.g. spring/summer/fall/winter (anime only).

references.description: Source shorthand -> merged {id, url?}. `url` is emitted only when a site link can be resolved; `id` is always present. Empty object when the entry carries no cross-references.

confidence.description: metadata_fuzzy merge confidence (0-100) on merged records. Absent on single-source passthrough records — the absence, not the reference shape, marks those.

score.description: Source score, opt-in via the exporter `score` toggle.

tags.description: Tag list, opt-in via the exporter `tags` toggle.

genres.description: Genre list, opt-in via the exporter `genres` toggle.

synopsis.description: Synopsis text, opt-in via the exporter `synopsis` toggle.

studios.description: Studio/author list, opt-in via the exporter `studios` toggle.

ml_score.description: metadata_ml model probability for the merge (second-stage scorer).

ml_model.description: Model identifier that produced ml_score (e.g. logreg-2026.10.16.122621).

ml_decided_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of the model decision.
